market_story: Overnight the West runs a structural non-emitting surplus — Northwest hydro spinning through the night and plains/desert wind — and the WEIM/EDAM greenhouse-gas attribution assigns those surplus resources to the transfers CAISO leans on, so the marginal overnight import into California pays NO unspecified-import carbon adder and no point-to-point wheel: it clears at essentially the raw Palo Verde hub price (the measured CAISO-hub spread is parity-consistent in 93-99% of overnight hours, all three years). CC_REGULAR: California's own combined-cycle fleet therefore backs down overnight to the residual the interties cannot serve — it does not run at import parity, because the real marginal import is cheaper than the carbon-wedged rung the model used to charge; the keeper's CC over-run closes economically, not by a floor. imports: the south corridor carries 4.5-6.5 GW through the night at clean attribution, matching the measured share of the overnight supply split.
